params.ddnn2_search: 128 trials per fold; min(4, B_f) most recent batches, then the best ceil(N/3) on all B_f; mean seven-level pinball in EUR/MWh after inversion, pooled over the scored hours of the batches each trial ran

params.interval_method: HG's H layer re-estimated on v5's own errors
params.member_weight: 1/6 for DDNN-2 inside LightGBM's third; fixed before any fit, never estimated
params.policy_definition: the single eligible candidate; central A1_w/3 + B2_w/3 + L-N/12 + L-R/12 + D2/6 = (2/3)c_HG + (1/6)L + (1/6)D2
params.weather_features: v4's three GFS columns plus missing indicators (an optional input group)
